newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST - Jyske Bank Q3 seen up 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Jyske Bank Q3 seen up 10 pct.

text.p: Denmark's fourth biggest bank Jyske Bank A/S is forecast to raise its profit before tax and extraordinary items by 10 percent to 795 million crowns for the first nine months of 1996, according to a survey of five analysts carried out by Reuters on Tuesday.
The bank's pre-tax ordinary result for 1995's first nine months was 723 million crowns. Third quarter 1996 results are due to be released on Wednesday, October 30.
Jyske Bank had a whole year 1995 pre-tax result before extraordinary items of 961 million crowns.
The five analysts' estimates ranged from a low expectation of 735 million crowns to a high of 830 million crowns.
